title: How Big Is Venus Compared to Earth?
description:
What Happened to Venus?
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VBaYRPp85Sw

Venus is ninety-five percent as wide as Earth, with about four-fifths of its mass.

Sources: NASA, Venus Fact Sheet (volumetric mean radius ratio 0.950; mass ratio 0.815). https://nssdc.gsfc.nasa.gov/planetary/factsheet/venusfact.html

Pictures: NASA/JPL-Caltech Magellan imagery (PIA00257, PIA00200, PIA00109, S91-50688) and the NASA full-disk cloudy Venus globe (PIA23791), plus a NASA SDO Venus transit, alongside AI-assisted voice and editing. Facts: every number is checked against the sources listed above.
Image credits: NASA/JPL-Caltech; NASA SDO.
